_what_this_is: Where each file in command-center/sources/ came from. These are SOURCE FILES copied from the public platform repository, not endpoint responses and not approvals. A test recomputes the git blob hash of each file and fails if it no longer matches.

files.note: The capability research file the platform's agent-domain routes read. Every capability in it is requirement_validation_state draft: nobody has agreed it.

design_system._what_this_is: The Colaberry design-system token files the Command Center's stylesheet is built on, copied byte for byte into command-center/vendor/colaberry-ds/ and pinned to one upstream commit (Aleem's review of PR #1, 2026-11-08, required change 1). tests/design-system.test.mjs recomputes each git blob hash.

not_vendored.why: It loads Roboto from the Google Fonts CDN and an icon font from jsDelivr. The repository ships no font files to self-host (assets/fonts/ holds only LICENSES.md), so adopting it adds an external dependency. Not added: pending platform design-system decision (Mihret, 2026-11-09). The page uses the --font-body token, which names Roboto first and falls back to the system font.
An optional element layer (body 18px, h1 48px, link and focus defaults). Adopting it is a type-scale change, which the review lists separately as item 7 for the next revision.

platform_code.what: AUTONOMY_MEANINGS (the ten rungs, owner's wording) and effectiveAuthority(), ported line for line.
The product_experience registry entry: agent_id null, can_reach_surface false, and its blocker text.
rowFor() sets effective_authority to null for every capability: no approval is recorded anywhere.
Coordinated handoff between two agents does not exist in the platform today, so autonomy:R8 is unreachable by fact.
sources.capabilities names GET /api/admin/agent-domains/<domain> as the source of capability records (CAPABILITY_SOURCE_NOTE, PANEL_ENDPOINTS).

GET /api/admin/agent-domains/:domainKey returns the domain view, accountable human, releases and story count, but not the capability records, so panels 2-4 show source-file values. GET /api/admin/agent-domains-mine returns not_recorded (autonomy_level_set_by).
The agent fields each agent-domains-mine row carries since AF3.9 (MINE_AGENT_FIELDS); all null when no ai_agents row is linked.
